fields.headline: STABLEFORD.
fields.body: Every card its own, and a bad hole costs nothing more than nothing.

fields.headline: POINTS, NOT STROKES.
fields.body: Two points for a net par, three for a birdie, one for a bogey, nothing worse. Pick up when the hole is gone and walk to the next tee.

fields.headline: 95 PER CENT.
fields.body: Each player gets 95% of their course handicap, in full, on the stroke index. There is no difference to play off when every card is its own.

fields.headline: BEST CARDS COUNT.
fields.body: Groups of four, two from each team. The best cards from each team are added up and the higher total takes the session. You choose how many count.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
